island.protest2: Stop, stop! I'm a robot, not a button
island.emptyChat: Ask me anything. If you want me to look at your screen, press “Look at my screen”.
error.missingKey: The API key is missing. Add it in Settings → Artificial intelligence.
error.invalidKey: The API key isn't valid. Check it in Settings.
error.rateLimited: You've hit the usage limit. Wait a bit and try again.
error.network: Can't reach the AI service. Check your internet connection.
error.ollamaOffline: Ollama isn't responding. Open it and try again.
error.model: That model isn't available. Pick another one in Settings.
error.refused: The model declined to answer this.
error.keyring: I couldn't use the system keychain.
island.defaultQuestion: What do you see on my screen? Can you help me with what I'm doing?
error.blocked: I won't look: a protected app is on screen ({message}).
error.screenPermission: I need Screen Recording permission. Turn it on for Tico in System Settings and reopen it.
settings.title: Tico settings
settings.followCursor: Appear on the monitor where the mouse is
settings.followCursorHint: If off, it always appears on the main monitor.
settings.hideOnFullscreen: Don't appear over full-screen apps (games, video)
settings.apiKeyHint: The key is stored in your system keychain, never in a file. You only pay for what you use on your provider account.
settings.ollamaHint: Install Ollama and download a vision model, for example: ollama pull gemma3
settings.captureMode.screen: The screen where the mouse is
settings.captureConfirm: Show me the thumbnail before sending
settings.blockedAppsHint: One per line. If any is on screen (in the app name or the window title), Tico won't capture anything.
settings.shortcutHint: Click and press the new combination (with Ctrl/⌘, Alt or Shift). Esc cancels.
settings.privacy: No telemetry and no accounts. Screenshots and the conversation only live in memory while Tico is open.
